scope: Pinned BWM action-adapter one-clip GPU training smoke
summary: The audited public BWM path completed one real video/action training step and saved an action-adapter checkpoint on physical A800 GPU 7.
evidence: Official BWM step-12000 was verified at 10051484872 bytes with SHA-256 75f863b9474d6e74934db45bb85728fef0adece3d123c667b78349bdade9c7f3.
The run loaded three verified Wan2.2 DiT shards, the verified VAE, BWM weights, one 57-frame video, nine history frames, and 14D action.
One forward/backward/optimizer step completed in 5.78 seconds and epoch-0.safetensors was saved at 199275904 bytes.
The run recorded CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES selection, physical GPU 7 inventory, process inventory, source/model revisions, packages, seed, command, logs, and outputs.
lessons: The public training release requires seven narrow, hashed compatibility patches before its documented BWM data and history contracts execute end to end.
A one-clip smoke is useful acceptance for the training mechanism but supplies no comparative model-quality evidence.
limitations: This is one optimization step on a released BWM demo clip, not a balanced RoboTwin training campaign.
The checkpoint was not evaluated against baselines, WorldArena, cross-embodiment trials, or a physical robot.
The run log warns that the host kernel 5.4.119 is below Accelerate's recommended 5.5 minimum and that NCCL cleanup was not called by the public runner.
next_actions: Train matched-seed multi-embodiment candidates only after capacity is reserved, then run the frozen promotion suites.
Obtain operator-approved calibrated robot access before starting the real-robot protocol.
